content.short: Prismapad is a bonding-curve token launchpad on Stable, trading every token in native USDT0.
content.description: Prismapad is a bonding-curve launchpad on Stable: every token launches its full supply on a constant-product curve and trades in USDT0, the chain's native asset. A flat 1% trade fee is split evenly between the token creator and the protocol. Pricing tokens directly in a dollar stablecoin rather than a volatile gas token is a distinctive consequence of building on Stable.
